p: Service for displaying file and folder dialogs across different platforms

pre.code: public async Task<string?> SelectFolderAsync(string? initialDirectory = null)

ul.li: initialDirectory (string?): The initial directory to show in the dialog (Default: null)
The selected folder path, or null if cancelled

pre.code: public async Task<string?> OpenFileAsync(string? initialDirectory = null, string? filter = null)

ul.li: initialDirectory (string?): The initial directory to show in the dialog (Default: null)
filter (string?): The file filter to apply (Default: null)
The selected file path, or null if cancelled

pre.code: public async Task<string?> SaveFileAsync(string? initialDirectory = null, string? defaultFileName = null, string? filter = null)

ul.li: initialDirectory (string?): The initial directory to show in the dialog (Default: null)
defaultFileName (string?): The default file name to suggest (Default: null)
filter (string?): The file filter to apply (Default: null)
The selected file path for saving, or null if cancelled
